name: Reflecting
overview: Scripture reveals that humans are created in God's image, entrusted with dominion over the earth, reflecting His likeness and authority (Genesis 1:26). Our proper response to this divine design is worship and humble service, as seen in the call to bow before the LORD and present ourselves as living sacrifices (Psalms 95:6; Romans 12:1). In Christ, all distinctions that might separate us are transcended, uniting believers as one body reflecting God's grace and unity (Galatians 3:28). This reflection of God's character is both a privilege and a responsibility, shaping how we live and relate to others in humility and worship.
